acceptance_tests: N1: for each of {residual/comeager (Baire), full-measure wrt a specified measure class, open-dense-escape, complement-of-finite-codimension}: definition; ambient space and topology/measure needed; resulting quantifier form
N2: for each ordered pair state transfer holds/fails/open; 'fails' needs an explicit witness or named primary source; 'holds' needs the extra hypothesis spelled out
N4: mark every citation unresolved unless fetched and quoted verbatim; no theorem claim
N5: usable as the genericity section of the three canonical schemas (key names fixed in rule_spec.json R07)
do_not_claim: No node completion, no theorem, no physics result. Report unverified; the schema owner (lead-formulation) binds interpretation. Write only under your own artifacts/<worker>/ path.
falsifier: If two notions are shown equivalent under stated hypotheses, the rule 'genericity notion is part of the class' is falsified for that pair; report as a direction update, do not hide it.
stop_rule: 3.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.
title: Genericity-notion separation matrix with transfer-failure witnesses (your L1 anchor proposal referred to lead-literature).
